<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Happy Monthsary, Baby!!</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link
    href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,300;9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Caveat:wght@500;600;700&display=swap"
    rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #FFF6F9;
      --cream: #FFE3EE;
      --pink: #FF6FA0;
      --pink-soft: #FFC2DB;
      --deep: #AD1457;
      --plum: #3C1030;
      --gold: #F2B705;
      --paper: #FFFBFC;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--plum);
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    h1,
    h2,
    .display {
      font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .script {
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
    }

    section {
      position: relative;
    }

    /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 10%, #FFEAF2 0%, #FFD4E4 55%, #FFC2DB 100%);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hearts-field {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .floaty-heart {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -10vh;
      color: var(--pink-soft);
      opacity: 0.7;
      animation-name: floatUp;
      animation-timing-function: ease-in;
      animation-iteration-count: infinite;
    }

    @keyframes floatUp {
      0% {
        transform: translateY(0) translateX(0) rotate(0deg);
        opacity: 0;
      }

      10% {
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      50% {
        transform: translateY(-55vh) translateX(15px) rotate(20deg);
      }

      90% {
        opacity: 0.5;
      }

      100% {
        transform: translateY(-115vh) translateX(-15px) rotate(-15deg);
        opacity: 0;
      }
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 780px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--deep);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid rgba(173, 20, 87, 0.25);
      padding: 0.4rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .headline {
      font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 9vw, 6.2rem);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 0.98;
      color: var(--deep);
      text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    }

    .headline .accent {
      font-style: italic;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--pink);
    }

    .subline {
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.4vw, 2.3rem);
      color: var(--plum);
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .hero-date {
      margin-top: 2rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--deep);
    }

    .scroll-cue {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 2rem;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 2;
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      color: var(--deep);
      animation: bounce 2s infinite;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    @keyframes bounce {

      0%,
      100% {
        transform: translate(-50%, 0);
      }

      50% {
        transform: translate(-50%, 10px);
      }
    }

    /* ---------- COUNTDOWN ---------- */
    .countdown-section {
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--pink);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 2.8rem);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--deep);
      margin: 0.5rem 0 2.5rem;
    }

    .countdown-grid {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .countdown-box {
      background: var(--paper);
      border: 1px solid var(--pink-soft);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 1.4rem 1.2rem;
      min-width: 96px;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(173, 20, 87, 0.25);
    }

    .countdown-num {
      font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--deep);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .countdown-label {
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--plum);
      opacity: 0.7;
    }

    .countdown-done {
      display: none;
      font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 2.6rem);
      color: var(--deep);
    }

    /* ---------- GALLERY ---------- */
    .gallery-section {
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem 6rem;
      background: var(--cream);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .gallery-grid {
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr));
      gap: 2rem 1.5rem;
      padding-top: 1rem;
    }

    .polaroid {
      background: #fff;
      padding: 0.7rem 0.7rem 1.4rem;
      border-radius: 4px;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 25px -12px rgba(60, 16, 48, 0.35);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease;
    }

    .polaroid:nth-child(odd) {
      transform: rotate(-3deg);
    }

    .polaroid:nth-child(even) {
      transform: rotate(2deg);
    }

    .polaroid:hover {
      transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03);
    }

    .polaroid-photo {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      border-radius: 2px;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFE1EC, #FFC9DE);
    }

    .polaroid-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      border-radius: 2px;
      border: 2px dashed var(--pink-soft);
      background: #FFF3F8;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--deep);
      gap: 0.4rem;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.5rem;
    }

    .polaroid-caption {
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--plum);
      margin-top: 0.6rem;
    }

    /* ---------- REASONS ---------- */
    .reasons-section {
      padding: 5rem 1.5rem;
      background: var(--bg);
    }

    .reasons-list {
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 2.5rem auto 0;
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.4rem;
    }

    .reasons-list li {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: flex-start;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .reason-bullet {
      flex: none;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--pink);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-top: 0.15rem;
    }

    /* ---------- LETTER / ENVELOPE ---------- */
    .letter-section {
      padding: 6rem 1.5rem 7rem;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--cream), #FFD9E9);
      text-align: center;
      perspective: 1400px;
    }

    .envelope-wrap {
      max-width: 420px;
      margin: 2.5rem auto 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .envelope {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
    }

    .envelope-body {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--paper);
      border: 1px solid var(--pink-soft);
      border-radius: 10px;
      box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -18px rgba(173, 20, 87, 0.4);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .envelope-body::before,
    .envelope-body::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      width: 50%;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--cream);
    }

    .envelope-body::before {
      left: 0;
      clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 0 100%);
    }

    .envelope-body::after {
      right: 0;
      clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%);
    }

    .envelope-flap {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 55%;
      background: var(--pink);
      clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 50% 100%);
      transform-origin: top;
      transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(.6, -0.28, .44, 1.4);
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .envelope-seal {
      position: absolute;
      top: 42%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--deep);
      color: white;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      z-index: 4;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    }

    .envelope-hint {
      margin-top: 1.2rem;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--deep);
      opacity: 0.75;
    }

    .envelope-wrap.open .envelope-flap {
      transform: rotateX(180deg);
    }

    .letter-card {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 2.5rem auto 0;
      background: var(--paper);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
      box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -20px rgba(60, 16, 48, 0.35);
      text-align: left;
      white-space: pre-line;
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      display: none;
    }

    .letter-card.visible {
      display: block;
    }

    .letter-signature {
      font-family: 'Caveat', cursive;
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      color: var(--deep);
      margin-top: 1rem;
      display: block;
    }

    .close-letter {
      display: block;
      margin: 1.2rem auto 0;
      background: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--deep);
      color: var(--deep);
      padding: 0.5rem 1.4rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
    footer {
      padding: 3rem 1.5rem;
      text-align: center;
      background: var(--deep);
      color: #FFE3EE;
    }

    footer .footer-title {
      font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    footer .footer-sub {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .floaty-heart {
        animation: none;
        opacity: 0;
      }

      .scroll-cue {
        animation: none;
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>

<body>

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="hearts-field" id="heartsField"></div>
    <div class="hero-content">
      <span class="eyebrow">First Monthsary</span>
      <h1 class="headline">Happy<br><span class="accent">Monthsary,</span><br>Baby!!</h1>
      <p class="subline">one whole month of loving you 💌</p>
      <p class="hero-date" id="heroDate">July 29, 2026</p>
    </div>
    <a href="#countdown" class="scroll-cue" aria-label="Scroll down">↓</a>
  </section>

  <section class="countdown-section" id="countdown">
    <p class="section-eyebrow">Almost there</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">Counting down to our big day</h2>
    <div class="countdown-grid" id="countdownGrid">
      <div class="countdown-box">
        <div class="countdown-num" id="cd-days">00</div>
        <div class="countdown-label">Days</div>
      </div>
      <div class="countdown-box">
        <div class="countdown-num" id="cd-hours">00</div>
        <div class="countdown-label">Hours</div>
      </div>
      <div class="countdown-box">
        <div class="countdown-num" id="cd-mins">00</div>
        <div class="countdown-label">Minutes</div>
      </div>
      <div class="countdown-box">
        <div class="countdown-num" id="cd-secs">00</div>
        <div class="countdown-label">Seconds</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="countdown-done" id="countdownDone">It's finally here — happy monthsary, baby! 🩷</p>
  </section>

  <section class="gallery-section">
    <p class="section-eyebrow">Our little moments</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">A month, in pictures</h2>
    <div class="gallery-grid" id="galleryGrid"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="reasons-section">
    <p class="section-eyebrow" style="text-align:center;">Just a few, out of many</p>
    <h2 class="section-title" style="text-align:center;">Reasons I'm falling for you</h2>
    <ul class="reasons-list" id="reasonsList"></ul>
  </section>

  <section class="letter-section">
    <p class="section-eyebrow">One more thing</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">A little letter for you</h2>
    <div class="envelope-wrap" id="envelopeWrap">
      <div class="envelope">
        <div class="envelope-body"></div>
        <div class="envelope-flap"></div>
        <div class="envelope-seal">🩷</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="envelope-hint" id="envelopeHint">tap the envelope to open</p>
    <div class="letter-card" id="letterCard">
      <div id="letterText"></div>
      <button class="close-letter" id="closeLetter">close letter</button>
    </div>
  </section>

  <footer>
    <div class="footer-title">Happy Monthsary, Baby 🩷</div>
    <div class="footer-sub">here's to many, many more</div>
  </footer>

  <script>
    // =====================================================
    // ✏️  EDIT YOUR DETAILS HERE — everything below is what
    //     you'll want to personalize before sharing this.
    // =====================================================
    const content = {
      // The exact moment your monthsary lands (year, month, day, time).
      monthsaryDate: "2026-07-29T00:00:00",

      // Reasons list — swap these for things that are actually true about her/you two.
      reasons: [
        "The way you make me feel understood without having to explain everything.",
        "You love me in ways that make me feel safe.",
        "How you're always willing to listen, even to my random thoughts.",
        "You make me excited for the future.",
        "The comfort of knowing I can always be myself around you.",
        "One month in, and you already feel like home."
      ],

      // The love letter. \n\n makes a new paragraph.
      letter: "Hi babyy!!\n\nFirst of all, Happy First Monthsary, baby! Thank you for making this past month one of the happiest and most meaningful parts of my life. Every moment with you, no matter how simple, has become something I always look forward to.\n\nThank you for choosing me, loving me, and being so patient with me through everything. I hope you know how much I appreciate all the little things you do and how grateful I am to have someone as amazing as you.\n\nAs we celebrate this little milestone, I hope this is only the beginning of many more months and years together. No matter what comes our way, I'll keep choosing you, loving you, and doing my best to make you feel as special as you make me feel.\n\nI love you so much, babyy. Happy first monthsary again, and here's to us. 🤍",
      signature: "",

      // Photos: replace null with a file path (e.g. "photos/us-1.jpg") once you
      // add real pictures next to this HTML file. Leave as null for a placeholder.
      photos: [
        { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "day one 🩷" },
        { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "our first date" },
        { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "just us" },
        { src: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", caption: "more to come..." }
      ]
    };
    // =====================================================
    // End of editable section. No need to touch anything below.
    // =====================================================

    // Hero date, formatted nicely
    document.getElementById('heroDate').textContent =
      new Date(content.monthsaryDate).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });

    // Floating hearts
    const heartsField = document.getElementById('heartsField');
    const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    if (!reduceMotion) {
      const heartSVG = (size) => `<svg width="${size}" height="${size}" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 21s-6.7-4.35-9.3-8.2C.8 9.7 1.7 6 5 4.9c2-.65 3.9.15 5 1.85 1.1-1.7 3-2.5 5-1.85 3.3 1.1 4.2 4.8 2.3 7.9C18.7 16.65 12 21 12 21z"/></svg>`;
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const h = document.createElement('div');
        h.className = 'floaty-heart';
        const size = 10 + Math.random() * 18;
        h.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%';
        h.style.animationDuration = (7 + Math.random() * 8) + 's';
        h.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 8) + 's';
        h.innerHTML = heartSVG(size);
        heartsField.appendChild(h);
      }
    }

    // Countdown
    const target = new Date(content.monthsaryDate).getTime();
    const grid = document.getElementById('countdownGrid');
    const doneMsg = document.getElementById('countdownDone');
    function tick() {
      const diff = target - Date.now();
      if (diff <= 0) {
        grid.style.display = 'none';
        doneMsg.style.display = 'block';
        clearInterval(timer);
        return;
      }
      const d = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
      const h = Math.floor((diff % 86400000) / 3600000);
      const m = Math.floor((diff % 3600000) / 60000);
      const s = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
      document.getElementById('cd-days').textContent = String(d).padStart(2, '0');
      document.getElementById('cd-hours').textContent = String(h).padStart(2, '0');
      document.getElementById('cd-mins').textContent = String(m).padStart(2, '0');
      document.getElementById('cd-secs').textContent = String(s).padStart(2, '0');
    }
    tick();
    const timer = setInterval(tick, 1000);

    // Gallery
    const galleryGrid = document.getElementById('galleryGrid');
    content.photos.forEach(p => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'polaroid';
      if (p.src) {
        card.innerHTML = `<img class="polaroid-photo" src="${p.src}" alt="${p.caption}">
        <div class="polaroid-caption">${p.caption}</div>`;
      } else {
        card.innerHTML = `<div class="polaroid-placeholder">📷<br>add your photo here</div>
        <div class="polaroid-caption">${p.caption}</div>`;
      }
      galleryGrid.appendChild(card);
    });

    // Reasons
    const reasonsList = document.getElementById('reasonsList');
    content.reasons.forEach((r, i) => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.innerHTML = `<span class="reason-bullet">🩷</span><span>${r}</span>`;
      reasonsList.appendChild(li);
    });

    // Envelope / letter
    const envelopeWrap = document.getElementById('envelopeWrap');
    const letterCard = document.getElementById('letterCard');
    const letterText = document.getElementById('letterText');
    const envelopeHint = document.getElementById('envelopeHint');
    const closeLetter = document.getElementById('closeLetter');

    letterText.innerHTML = content.letter.split('\n\n').map(p => `<p>${p}</p>`).join('') +
      `<span class="letter-signature">${content.signature}</span>`;

    envelopeWrap.addEventListener('click', () => {
      envelopeWrap.classList.add('open');
      setTimeout(() => {
        letterCard.classList.add('visible');
        envelopeHint.style.visibility = 'hidden';
        letterCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'center' });
      }, reduceMotion ? 0 : 350);
    });

    closeLetter.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      letterCard.classList.remove('visible');
      envelopeWrap.classList.remove('open');
      envelopeHint.style.visibility = 'visible';
    });
  </script>

</body>

</html>
